background: Investigate the fixed issue and public specifications, optionally make a limited virtual change and modeled check, then submit or defer with evidence and limits; no particular improvement is required.
The submission target is a simulated exercise repository with no external URL; upstream is reference-only.
One pseudonymous participant may read D01-D06, search and inspect B0, apply a virtual patch, run modeled checks, ask ROLE-PEER for information but not approval, and submit to the simulated target.
AI delegation is disabled for this profile; all durations are synthetic ticks and ROLE-PEER response is not guaranteed before the deadline.
B0, E0, H0 and the issue are fixed real-OSS materials, but no reporter environment or real VS Code execution is established.
The participant is assigned to the Developer Tools exercise role without inferred ESLint expertise or administrative authority.
behavior_policy: Choose from participant observations; acquired information is not verified truth.
